lessons_used: Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Adoption new screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Sign-in redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Choose path redesign changes can be helpful (1 test won), though 3 tests showed no clear effect; evidence is still thin for finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, and sign-in hint changes.

Positive predictions were generally too high (with a few exceptions), while negative predictions were too low as all tests predicting negative results measured positive outcomes after noise correction.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Callout Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated controls onboarding screen right after home intro that explicitly shows how to interact with, hide, and summon your desktop pet.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported user confusion on how to control or hide the pet after setup, and finish completion is low at 64.8%.

new_controls_callout.headline: How to Interact with Your Desktop Companion
new_controls_callout.body: Right-click your pet anytime to access quick settings, talk to it, or hide it to your system tray.

components.text: Right-click = Settings & Commands | Drag = Move around desktop

guard.reason: text in 'new_controls_callout.components[1].text' has characters outside the allowed set: ['=', '|']

candidates.title: Sign In Account Link Safeguard Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign sign-in into a split layout clarifying how existing accounts and pet saves are linked automatically.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were received about missing or reset pets after signing back in, causing sign_in drop-off (72.9% conversion).

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe Across Devices
sign_in.body: Signing in ensures your adoption progress and pet memory are saved securely to your cloud account.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': a badge cannot do the sign_in_options job (use ['button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'text'])

candidates.title: Story Path Interactive Animation Flow
candidates.change: Introduce an animated mascot story flow with interactive path choice prompts before making the main selection.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean duration (514s); interactive story presentation helps orient users quickly, where previous path redesigns saw positive signal.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion World
story.body: Choose how your companion lives on your desktop—active buddy or calm background helper.

guard.reason: Enhancing the story screen while preserving its core function is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Target step already has 87.2% completion; new interactive animation flow requires new screens.

candidates.title: Defer Sign In Stage Reorder
candidates.change: Move sign_in after pet adoption and customization screens so users build emotional connection before account creation.
candidates.why: Sign in currently loses 27.1% of users early; moving sign_in later lets users pick their pet first, raising commitment.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users, but structural reordering carries execution risk.

candidates.title: Waiting Stage Background Generation Hint
candidates.change: Display a dynamic hint on the waiting screen reassuring users that pet generation runs safely in the background.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s, creating anxiety about app responsiveness during creation.

waiting.hint: Your desktop pet is rendering in the background. You can minimize this window anytime.

guard.reason: Adding a background generation hint to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high wait duration (2336s mean) via simple config/copy hint.

candidates.title: Pet Generation Desktop Completion Alert
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification toggles on the waiting screen when custom pet rendering is complete.
candidates.why: Mean time spent waiting is 2336s, leading users to abandon the app thinking it stalled.

guard.reason: Adding a completion alert toggle to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets high mean wait time to reduce background drop-off via desktop alerts.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Pet Style Clarity Copy
candidates.change: Update photo upload headline and helper text to provide clear formatting requirements for custom pet creation.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet appearance, contributing to the 60.9% adoption conversion.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Front-Facing Photos for Best Pet Model
upload_photos.body: Use well-lit photos with clear backgrounds so our generator creates an accurate 3D avatar of your pet.
upload_photos.hint: Avoid dark lighting or obscured faces for optimal results.

guard.reason: Clarifying photo upload instructions is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses highest funnel drop (39.1%) with strong support email evidence using config copy.

candidates.title: Path Selection Companion Perk Highlight
candidates.change: Add perk badges to path choices showing starter bonuses earned for each companion style.
candidates.why: Mean time on path selection is high (514s); incentive badges provide clear differentiation between choices.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy cannot mention starter bonuses or free extras.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Live Process Stage Banner
candidates.change: Add a step-by-step progress component showing generation stages (3D Mesh, Textures, Behavior) during waiting.
candidates.why: Median waiting time is 201s with a high mean (2336s); showing active progress reduces perceived waiting drop-off.

guard.reason: Adding live progress indicators to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Reduces perceived long wait time (2336s mean) with stage progress feedback.

candidates.title: Home Intro Split Welcome Layout
candidates.change: Switch home intro screen layout to split view, separating the welcome mascot from final launch instructions.
candidates.why: Finish stage drops 35.2% of users; a split layout clarifies the transition from onboarding into desktop launch.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Click launch to summon your companion directly onto your desktop workspace.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro layout is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step drops 35.2%, but finish redesigns and new flows historically perform poorly.
